== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 18 March 2017. The Facebook photo viewer names Robert Blandford. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 94 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Haberfield, Aus), printed on the roster as Robert Blanford. The Facebook profile is facebook.com/robert.blandford.5. The Facebook profile does not list a hometown.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Robert Blandford portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Robert Blandford Facebook portrait.jpg]].
